title: Send a file to another computer using netcat
summary: Use netcat to transfer a file directly between two computers over the network. One computer listens on a port, and the other connects to send the file.

steps.explain: On the receiving computer, start a netcat listener on a specific port and redirect the output to a file where the received data will be saved.

placeholders.name: FILENAME
placeholders.description: The name of the file to send (used in the sending step, but defined here for context of the pair)

placeholders.name: PORT
placeholders.description: The TCP port number to listen on

steps.explain: On the sending computer, connect to the receiver's IP address and port, and redirect the file content into the connection.

placeholders.name: HOST
placeholders.description: The IP address or hostname of the receiving computer

placeholders.name: PORT
placeholders.description: The same port number used by the listener

placeholders.name: RECEIVED_FILENAME
placeholders.description: The name of the file to create on the receiving side
